en: Fixed Claude not being told the cause when a file attached to a message sent over Remote Control or to a cloud session could not be saved because the disk was full, or that a message's attachments past the first 20 were left out
zh: 修复了以下问题：通过远程控制发送或发送到云端 session 的消息所附文件因磁盘已满而无法保存时，Claude 未被告知原因；消息中第 20 个之后的附件被遗漏时也未告知
